content.text: Rim only 0.7. Wait for enemies near a wall. Move to south wall? Let's go to the back area instead... stay near south wall.
Enemies approach. Punch toward the nearest (northwest).
Fighting the last enemy; debris is settling into scattered piles. I'll finish it and then work on stacking kills against a wall.
Still brawling at the south wall (HP 44, 4 enemies approaching). Letting them come to me and kicking when they're in range.
Two 2-HP enemies close; punch is fast.
I died in box 1 and escaped no boxes. I got 7 kills (score 1050). A thug hit me for 22 damage at 20 HP. The debris from my kills never piled up high enough against a wall to climb out.
